name: CSI: Clean Scene Investigators Main Website Authority Map

historicalAuditedBaseline.note: Historical baseline only. The commercial website may grow beyond this count.

policy: The GoDaddy website at cleansceneinvestigators.com is the canonical commercial source of truth.
The current main-site URL registry is regenerated during every Knowledge Center deployment from the live GoDaddy sitemap.
GoDaddy /f/ blog articles are supporting indexable content and are tracked separately from designed primary pages.
Known duplicate/system routes are tracked separately rather than promoted as authority pages.
Exact city and service URLs must come from the live sitemap or canonical site navigation and must never be fabricated.
CSI is one mobile service-area business and does not publish separate offices for each city.
